how can I prove a stack trace?

If `:version` says you have build type Debug or RelWithDebInfo, the core file will have the necessary info to get a backtrace. Then just read [this wiki section](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/wiki/Development-tips#backtrace-linux). If a core file wasn't produced, that wiki section also mentions how to enable it. Typically `ulimit -c unlimited` must be run in the shell first (it's not a permanent setting).

nevermind, I was looking in the local dir. I did a `brew install gdb` and ran it against the core as instructed.
